hawaii.dds_name: Disability Determination Branch, Hawaii Department of Human Services
hawaii.state_note: Hawaii's Disability Determination Branch, in the Department of Human Services, makes the medical decision on SSDI and SSI claims and is 100 percent federally funded by SSA; no standalone official DDB webpage was found, so no DDS URL is listed.

idaho.dds_name: Idaho Disability Determinations Service, Idaho Department of Labor
idaho.state_note: Idaho's DDS is in the Idaho Department of Labor and decides medical eligibility for SSDI and SSI for Idahoans; Idaho also pays a state supplement for SSI recipients living in residential care or assisted-living facilities, administered by the Department of Health and Welfare. No official DDS webpage URL was found in search results, so no DDS URL is listed.

illinois.dds_name: Bureau of Disability Determination Services, Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Rehabilitation Services
illinois.state_note: Illinois' Bureau of Disability Determination Services, in Springfield, makes the medical decision on SSDI and SSI claims; Illinois runs its own SSI supplement, Aid to the Aged, Blind, or Disabled (AABD), through the Department of Human Services, separate from the federal SSI check.

indiana.dds_name: Indiana Disability Determination Bureau, Indiana Family and Social Services Administration
indiana.state_note: Indiana's Disability Determination Bureau, under the Family and Social Services Administration, makes the medical decision on SSDI and SSI claims; applications are filed with SSA, not with the Bureau. No standalone FSSA Bureau webpage URL was found, so the official SSA Chicago-region DDS page is listed instead.

iowa.dds_name: Iowa Disability Determination Services, Iowa Workforce Development
iowa.state_note: Iowa's DDS operates as a division within Iowa Workforce Development; in federal fiscal year 2025 it averaged 80.9 days to process an initial disability claim, compared with a 190-day national average. No official DDS webpage URL was found in search results, so no DDS URL is listed.

kansas.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, Kansas Department for Children and Families
kansas.state_note: Kansas DDS, in the Department for Children and Families, makes disability and blindness determinations for SSA on most SSDI and SSI claims filed in Kansas, and also makes Medicaid eligibility determinations for people who do not meet the financial requirements for SSI.

kentucky.dds_name: Department for Disability Determination Services, Kentucky Education and Labor Cabinet
kentucky.state_note: Kentucky's DDS, under the Education and Labor Cabinet, makes disability determinations for SSA and does not take benefit applications, which are filed with SSA; it also determines medical eligibility for KTAP and Medicaid. Kentucky divides free civil legal aid among four regional programs, and Kentucky Legal Aid covers 35 counties in western and south-central Kentucky.

louisiana.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, Louisiana Department of Health
louisiana.state_note: Louisiana's DDS moved from the Department of Children and Family Services to the Department of Health on October 1, 2025, and has offices in Baton Rouge, New Orleans, and Shreveport; Southeast Louisiana Legal Services covers 22 southeast parishes, while Acadiana Legal Service Corporation covers the other 42 parishes.

maine.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, Maine Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Family Independence
maine.state_note: Maine's single DDS office is in Winthrop, in the Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Family Independence; no standalone Maine DHHS DDS webpage URL was found, so the official SSA Boston-region Maine page is listed instead.

maryland.dds_name: Maryland Disability Determination Services, Division of Rehabilitation Services, Maryland State Department of Education
maryland.state_note: Maryland's DDS is a state agency within the Division of Rehabilitation Services (DORS) under the State Department of Education; a person approved for SSI in Maryland is granted Medicaid automatically.
